helper.cpu_selection: No --gpu flag; helper hides CUDA devices before backend initialization. No --cpu flag exists.
helper.warmup: The helper performs its built-in largest-square warmup before READY; client then sends one warmup ENC and three formal ENC requests per fixture.

protocol.sve1_header: five little-endian int32: magic 0x31455653, n_tokens, nx, ny, n_embd
protocol.validation: n_tokens == nx*ny, n_embd == 2560, exact body bytes, finite little-endian F32, bounded output size, per-file SHA-256
protocol.outputs: new timestamped run directory; each SVE output path is checked absent before ENC; stderr is an exclusive new file

client.default_behavior: validate-only; verifies fixture and built-helper hashes without spawning helper or reading model/mmproj
client.child: owned subprocess.Popen argv list, shell=false, hidden new process group, Idle priority, stderr file
client.fresh_resource_gate: tools.hetero_resources.memory_snapshot; >=12 GiB available physical and >=4 GiB available commit
client.timeout_stop_scope: Terminate/wait/kill applies only to the exact Popen-owned helper process. strata-vision is a direct native process and does not launch child processes; no PID/name-based process killing is used.
client.resource_gate_checkpoints: startup before/after input identity, then immediately before helper spawn and before/after every ENC; missing physical/commit telemetry fails closed
client.durable_progress_file: exclusive progress.jsonl; fsync after each event including complete raw response lines and resource gates
client.terminal_receipts: exclusive oracle-receipt.json on success; exclusive failed-oracle-receipt.json with phase/argv/PID/CreateTime/exit code/partial results on failure

tests: test_oracle_client.py uses only synthetic tiny SVE1 byte fixtures and validates no-spawn default mode
